9.text: In the third stage the man is unconscious of his surroundings, but he is

10.text: still active, walking or tumbling about on the ground, sometimes raving, and

11.text: breaking whatever happens to come into his hands. During this period the

12.text: agaric spirits take him through various worlds and show him strange sights

13.text: and peoples. Then a heavy slumber ensues, lasting for several hours, during

14.text: which it is impossible to rouse the sleeper. How persistent are the spirits’

15.text: commands is shown by the following instance of a man, who, when about to

16.text: retire, was ordered to lie down in the midst of his dog-team. Although he

17.text: was attacked by the dogs, we could not keep him away from them. He

18.text: finally succeeded in staying with the dogs all night.
